notes.title: Quiz, wallpapers, devlog and a milestone! 🎉
notes.content:
Hello everyone! The quiz is almost there, it will happen already this Sunday. Visit our Discord and make sure you don't miss your chance to get free access to the upcoming update. Regarding the update - we're actively working on it, we'll inform you about the release date soon, stick with us for more.

Thank you very much for your support - we're celebrating our first 100 subscribers on X!

There's a fresh set of wallpapers on our Patreon - visit and support to get them and all the previous ones, and get ready for the upcoming halloween ones. Here's a quick summary of what we've been working on - patrons get such information and exclusive content earlier:

📃Collectables - now there are collectable magazines to find.

🎮A lot of new mini-games - medical checkup, more yoga mini-games and even cleaning.

🌍New locations - explore new places, free exploration mode is back.

🎞Animations - over 30 new animations to enjoy finished so far.

🖼Story renders - over 600 of new story images are done by now.

📙Plot development - we keep telling the story of Adam, introducing new characters and keeping the previous plot going

We'll keep bringing more for our players to enjoy!

notes.title: The quiz is coming - don't miss your chance to get new content!
notes.content:
We appreciate all the feedback you're giving us regarding the remaster update - we're actively working on new content, gameplay elements, story and animations to enjoy. 

Next week we'll be hosting a quiz on our Discord server. The questions will be based on the story and characters of the game - the right answers will give you points, and in the end, players with the most points will win exclusive content and free access to the upcoming update - Day 2 of the story! 
Day 2 will be available exclusevily to our Patreon supporters, so don't miss out on your chance to get it for free!

Visit our Discord to check out the rules for the quiz and to let us know that you'll be taking part.

notes.title: The remastered version is out - download and play now! 😲
notes.content:
Improved graphics, completely new animations, redesigned characters, improved story and translation and much more is already available 


We took a lot of time and effort to remaster and improve the game based on player's feedback, and we're inviting new players and old fans to enjoy the game!

Further updates are going to be released shortly - a second day full of content is coming, and we'll keep on adding more to the story! Upcoming updates will be available exclusively to our Patrons - visit our Discord/X to get to know more. Patrons get wallpapers, exclusive content, custom animations, mentions in credits and early access to new content!

This is possible thanks to our fellow fans and their feedback - we really appreciate every single player and review!

notes.title: Remaster is coming soon! Read our devlog
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we've got great news for you! 😲

As we said before, a big update is coming, and it's going to be released faster than you think. We're currently finishing and polishing the game, most of the work is done already! 

A remastered version is going to be released apart from this one, we decided to keep both of them. Visit our social networks (X/Discord/Patreon/SubscribeStar) to see new content, animations and such! Here's a quick overview of our progress:

 Completely reworked English translation - we fixed every single mistake we could find. 
 300+ static images finished, integrated and looking completely astonishing.
 All the animations are finished, we're actively rendering and adding them into the game now.
 New mechanics, UI, sound-design and a bunch of other minor changes too!

Sex Coach: Hot Yoga - Prologue Remastered is coming in less than 2 weeks! It's going to be free, much better than the original and immediately after releasing it we'll start working on continuing the story and providing you with more content! 

Thanks for all of your feedback, it wouldn't happen without every single one of you!

Join our Discord server

notes.title: A big update is coming!
notes.content:
Foremost, thanks everyone for playing and sharing your honest feedback on the game! We've read through every single review and comment and decided to do a massive update - everything is undergoing massive change, so you can be sure that the wait was worth it. 

     We've completely redesigned characters, we're working on completely new animations with a fresh team, many minor nuances like sound-design and UI will be updated too - very soon the game will face major transformation for the better. To give you an idea of what's coming up - we've shared some new designs on our recently opened Patreon and SubscribeStar pages - feel free to visit them if you're intrigued! Links to all of our social networks can be found either inside the game or on our discord server - feel free to join!

This wouldn't be possible without every single one of you playing the game and sharing their thoughts - we hear you!
